blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu—A 31-year-old construction worker was arrested after offering a woman ₱1,000 in exchange for sex in Barangay Candaguit, Sibonga town on Saturday evening, September 19. Authorities identified the complainant as alias “Alice,” 26, a single mother and resident of Barangay Lindogon, Sibonga town. Meanwhile, they identified the suspect as alias “Ian,” a single resident of Barangay Nug-as, Alcoy town. He remained detained as of Sunday, September 20, in the Sibonga Municipal Police Station and will be facing charges for allegedly violating Republic Act 11313, otherwise known as the Safe Spaces Act.
